sections.title: Pulp/Dentin Biology
sections.description: Biology of Pulp/Dentin Complex Microcirculation COURSE GOALS/OBJECTIVES: 1. To give the student an understanding of the normal and abnormal biology of the dentin pulp complex. 2. To provide the student with fundamental information on clinically related subjects such as pain control and pulp capping procedures. 3. To provide the student with a general knowledge of the literature related to pulp biology. 4. To review the various physiological methods of investigating pulpal tissue.
